meta.title: CFB 2026 anchor/reference source manifest + dated capture
meta.purpose: Catalogue of consensus rating sources for the 2026 power-ratings pipeline, plus dated value captures.
meta.BLINDING: COMPUTE-PHASE ONLY. Every source here is a 2026 consensus/power rating. Per project rules these must NEVER be shown to the grading layer or copied into /snapshots. Use only in the blend code.
meta.team_naming: team_raw = each source's own spelling. norm_key = provisional cross-source key (validated identical across all 5 sources, 138/138). FINAL mapping target is the CFBD canonical team list (not yet wired).
meta.usage: anchors_overall_<date>.csv = one overall rating per team per source (5 x 138 = 690 rows) - the blend input. Per-source CSVs carry components (off/def splits, Massey Pwr, FPI proj W-L).
meta.capture_method: SP+/FEI via WebFetch 2026-07-12; Massey/FPI/TeamRankings transcribed from user's in-browser copy 2026-07-12 (browser extension not connected).
